text:
grace: Heads-up — I found KMS-wrapped ciphertext printed to staging CI logs. Looks like job `deploy-helper` prints VAULT_WRAPPED before unwrap. Not in prod. https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ci-logging (linked)

mike: ack. can you paste the exact log line (redacted) so we can confirm scope?

grace: sure — here's a redacted snippet:
```
INFO: deploying service-x
DEBUG: VAULT_WRAPPED=AWrap...REDACTED...==
INFO: deployment complete
```

lina: I see it. that `deploy-helper` prints env for debugging. I'll push a patch to stop printing env and add redaction. ETA ~15–20m.

grace: we need a short containment + rotation plan. propose:
1) Quarantine any staging artifacts that include the blob (move to locked GCS bucket).
2) Revoke the staging deploy service-account key(s) that could have accessed the wrapped blob.
3) Rotate the Vault transit key used for wrapping (staging transit key).
4) Rewrap backups / stored ciphertexts and reissue any long-lived creds.
5) Enable Vault audit logging for transit in staging (it was disabled).

mike: +1 to that sequence. I'll take steps 2+3. @lina please do step 1 and 4 where applicable.

lina: started quarantine: moved artifacts with matching regex to `gs://redwood-sec-quarantine/staging/2026-03-21/` and set object-level ACL to restricted.

vault-bot: Audit: vault-audit-staging enabled at 2026-03-21T14:10Z by lina. (automated message)

grace: command notes for rotation (staging):
```
# rotate transit key
vault write -f transit/keys/staging-deploy
# verify
vault read transit/keys/staging-deploy
# revoke SA key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=staging-deploy@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

mike: I'm running the rotation now and will validate with `vault list -format=json transit/keys` and check audit events for unwrap calls.

sre-oncall: quick vuln-triage note — this is scoped to staging, no evidence of exfiltration yet, but assume sensitive. mark as Sev3 for now and track timeline + owners.

lina: I opened PR 4823 that removes env dumping and adds a redaction util. also added a CI lint that fails if `VAULT_WRAPPED|SECRET` patterns are printed. cc @grace @mike

grace: after rotation, run a scan across recent CI logs and artifacts: `scripts/credfinder --bucket staging --since 2026-03-01 --pattern WA?PPED|WRAPPED` and notify any downstream teams.

mike: rotation complete — transit key rotated, old key marked deprecated. deleted two SA keys that were created last month. audit shows unwrap attempts only from staging-runner (expected). I'll ping when rewraps done.

lina: rewrap scripts started for persisted ciphertexts. PR merged and rollout to canary pipeline now. I've blocked the full rollout until we confirm clean scans.

grace: good. I'll file incident ticket IR-2026-013 and owners set to grace/mike/lina. Also we'll add postmortem action items: CI default redact, vault audit required for any transit key, RBAC tighten for SA key creation (restrict to infra-admins), and scheduled key rotation policy for staging (30d).

sre-oncall: please add the RBAC change to the infra sprint board and include migration notes for partners. assign to @mike.

mike: added task INFRA-1127 and scheduled a walkthrough with infra on Monday.

grace: thanks all. I'll run the final creds-scan in 1h and update IR ticket. :thumbsup:

lina: quick note — retaining quarantined objects for 7 days, then we purge unless sec requests otherwise.

mike: final scan done at 2026-03-21T15:10Z — no other matches. closing incident after 24h monitoring window.

grace: closing here, will attach timeline to IR-2026-013 and mark owners. thx everyone.
